prompt: Create an original 180 second Celtic acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp. Style: lilting compound-meter dance and modal melody. Tempo approximately 98 BPM; G minor. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A dynamic and expressive string ensemble piece, featuring a prominent accordion or bandoneon. It blends classical and folk-dance influences, with intricate melodies and a wide dynamic range. The mood shifts between playful, melancholic, and passionate sections.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和表现力的弦乐合奏曲，手风琴或班多钮琴音色突出。融合了古典和民间舞曲风格，旋律复杂，动态范围广。情绪在俏皮、忧郁和热情之间切换。
